She

meclizine.

___ is an ___ year-old right-handed woman with 
hyperlipidemia and ocular migraines who presented with acute 
onset vertigo.

Her symptoms improved over the course of 24 
hours but did not fully resolve.

Her MRI was negative for a 
stroke, but given the acute onset and history it is still 
possible she had an MRI-negative stroke.
# NEURO - we started the patient on aspirin 81mg QD.

In 
addition, her LDL Was found to be 160, so we started her on 
atorvastatin.

Given that her neurological symptoms improved, we 
are unsure if she had a stroke or peripheral vertigo, but we 
decided to modify her stroke risk factors in case it was a 
stroke.

# CARDIAC - we monitoed her on telemetry which did not show 
atrial fibrillation.
The Preadmission Medication list is accurate and complete.
